scope: Experimental native AMD64 containers and isolated Home Assistant Container: exact-source lifecycle validation plus separately recorded dedicated Sonoff firmware and switch trials

environment.radio: Dedicated Sonoff firmware 0.14 with two paired bench switches and three outputs. The accepted candidate lifecycle baseline is ready with controls disabled; physical trial phases are recorded separately.

gates.required_evidence: Reviewed committed source including the required ancestor, passing checks, clean-source build context hash, exact distribution/daemon/firmware-compatibility/integration versions, and source revision bound to the resulting artifact
Actual Docker image ID, linux/amd64 inspection, runtime version checks, build recipe and base-image identities; record a registry digest only if one exists and hash any delivered archive
Fresh startup, health, authenticated API, websocket behavior, persistent configuration/catalog/database, restart and container recreation with no radio access; rerun on the committed artifact
gates.limitation: A nonexistent serial port tests offline behavior; it does not prove simulated or physical radio control
gates.observed: Corrected candidate image passed no-radio f48-to-candidate source-revision replacement: authenticated API/WebSocket, non-root runtime, ingress Origin checks, persistent local catalog/state and SQLite integrity.

gates.required_evidence: Fresh integration installation against a known isolated simulated daemon, authentication, state updates, disconnect/reconnect, HA and daemon restart, and preserved entry/device/entity identity without duplicate registrations
gates.observed: Default simulated-endpoint rejection and explicit opt-in; authenticated API; three registered entities; two-gang ON/OFF; daemon reconnect and HA restart with stable registry identifiers; SQLite integrity; same-image companion recreation retained two peers and restored two-gang entities
gates.limitations: One-gang control unavailable because simulator startup reports use the wrong suffix; not a passing control test. Repeat acceptance on the clean committed artifact. Same-version restarts are not upgrades.

gates.observed: Disposable HA Container upgraded through manual ZIP replacement and full restart; preserved entry ID/data/options/token and three entity identities/names/areas; two-gang entity online
gates.limitations: No customized names/areas or automation created, so only existing unchanged fields were verified. No HACS, Supervisor, physical radio or daemon image version-upgrade claim.
gates.rollback: Manual 0.6.0 to official 0.5.2 ZIP/code rollback followed by full HA restart passed with the same entry/data/options and three entity registry identities; two-gang entity online. This is not daemon-image rollback.

gates.required_evidence: Record absence honestly. First-install/recreation is not a version upgrade. If a separately source-bound historical AMD64 build is used later, identify it as a test-built baseline and test preserved data plus rollback without claiming it was previously published.
gates.observed: Same-version candidate HA ZIP activated by a planned HA restart; candidate daemon, retained f48 daemon and candidate reapply each reached a current accepted HA event stream within 120 seconds with HA continuously running. Same network, peers, registry and 15 command records retained.
gates.limitation: Both source revisions identify as distribution 0.6.0. This is source-revision replacement and compatible daemon rollback, not a SemVer/HACS or public AMD64 upgrade. IP address remained unchanged; earlier DNS divergence is unexplained.

gates.required_evidence: Actual x86-64 Supervisor app discovery, installation, startup, options/ingress, data persistence, update and restoration with the intended image channel
gates.limitation: HA Container plus a companion daemon does not qualify the Supervisor app channel

gates.required_evidence: Confirm physical transfer, exact board/revision, USB topology/identity, current firmware, ownership and reviewed recovery path before an explicitly scoped hardware trial
gates.constraints: No automatic protocol commands or flash; writes only through the reviewed explicit action. Do not reuse ZB-GW04 policy or firmware.

gates.required_evidence: Exact-board provider and loader/security policy, reviewed private candidate and recovery artifacts, actual HA inspect/explicit install, independent application VERSION/CAPS/STATUS, explicit new-network initialization/handoff, and scoped failure/recovery checks on the clean AMD64 image
gates.constraints: No fabricated gateway baseline for the starting sniffer. Cancellation without a baseline cannot claim restored sniffer or gateway service. Recovery needs its own explicit action and passive sniffer verification. Keep firmware qualified:false until the relevant tests pass.

gates.contract: Explicit optional Prepare entry_method sonoff_sniffer_0_12 and entry_confirmed true; absent fields preserve manual entry. Fresh strict passive sniffer identity under the exact lease precedes durable permission and one fixed entry command. Complete expected loader menu is mandatory before a plan; Install remains separate.
gates.security_basis: Private exact-unit historical unsigned/unencrypted acceptance is a reviewed expectation, not a fresh security readback. Prepare must reject any observed contradiction.
gates.failure_boundary: No automatic replay after uncertain entry. Explicit server-gated manual reinspection may reconcile entry uncertainty only after worker cleanup; it cannot bypass possible-flash recovery.

gates.observed: User-operated ON and OFF on all three outputs matched fresh native and HA states; untargeted outputs and all 15 logical command records stayed unchanged. All outputs physically OFF and original disabled options restored.
gates.limitation: Physical feedback on f48 does not independently qualify all functions of a rebuilt candidate or other boards.

gates.required_evidence: Separately scoped enable/restart, fresh user readiness, one physical ON/OFF cycle with fresh native and HA feedback, unchanged ledger and final original disabled restoration. Planned restarts must not be counted as automatic reconnect results.
gates.observation: The user initially reported no change, then clarified that they had not pressed the physical button. The earlier attempt was not executed and is not evidence of a candidate failure. A fresh monitored redo is pending; no candidate physical-feedback pass is claimed.
history: Initial no-change report was recorded as unresolved while passive evidence was reviewed.
Direct user correction: the requested physical press had not occurred; user requested a redo.

gates.required_evidence: Supported architecture/channel verified, immutable versioned artifacts and complete release inventory, firmware qualification/redistribution gates satisfied, and reviewed release decision
gates.constraints: Do not change public ARM64 manifests, app architecture listing or immutable tags while AMD64 remains experimental
